description: Recovery implementation of approved S5: mechanically split monolithic pkg/api/handlers.go into route-family handlers_*.go files with centralized shared HTTP helpers, preserve all HTTP semantics and pkg/api test coverage after completed S1 factory save modes, satisfy backend size gates, and document handler ownership for maintainers.

context.customerAsk: Downstream of S1 recovery. Retry after network outage interrupted batch-program-net-recovery-batch-api-handlers-decomposition-recovery. Full spec: tasks/prd-api-handlers-decomposition.md — API handlers decomposition (S5 recovery).
context.problem: pkg/api/handlers.go remains a ~2,100-line monolith with backendsizecheck ignore, mixing work, factory, session, model, and events/status transport. Review cost is high and helper duplication is likely. The prior autonomous batch did not complete the split.
context.solution: Move-only decomposition inside package api: handlers_common.go for shared writers/decoders, handlers_work.go, handlers_factory.go, handlers_factory_sessions.go, handlers_models.go, handlers_events.go for route families, retire or slim handlers.go, keep provider_session_details.go separate, preserve S1 session PUT decode, run full pkg/api tests, and update development-guide-relevant-files.md with a route-family map.

acceptanceCriteria: All existing HTTP routes remain registered with unchanged methods, paths, status codes, and response shapes.
Shared JSON/error writers and decode helpers live in one common handlers file with no duplicates across route-family files.
Factory session PUT keeps S1 { mode, factory } decoding and SaveFactoryForSession-only delegation in the factory/session handler file.
Handlers continue to use apisurface interfaces only; no new concrete service coupling.
Monolithic handlers.go is removed or wiring-only; per-file backend size policy is satisfied without unjustified file-level waivers.
development-guide-relevant-files.md maps each handlers_*.go file to its route families.
Quality gate: typecheck, lint, and go test ./pkg/api/... pass for all changed behavior.

userStories.title: Centralize shared HTTP helpers
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want one shared place for JSON responses, error writing, and common decode utilities so route-family files do not fork transport behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: handlers_common.go owns writeJSON, writeError, writeErrorWithTargets, writeSSEDataJSON, errorFamilyForStatus, and shared body-decode helpers used by multiple route families.
No duplicate writeError or writeJSON implementations remain in other handler files after extraction.
Existing pkg/api tests that assert error JSON shape for bad requests still pass unchanged.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Extract work route handlers
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want work submission and query handlers isolated so work-transport changes do not touch factory or model routes.
acceptanceCriteria: handlers_work.go owns SubmitWork, SubmitWorkBySessionId, UpsertWorkRequest, UpsertWorkRequestBySessionId, ListWork, ListWorkBySessionId, GetWork, GetWorkBySessionId, and work-list projection helpers.

POST /work still rejects missing or empty name with BAD_REQUEST before domain normalization; canonical work-request validation still routes through pkg/factory.ValidateCanonicalWorkRequestJSON with API-owned message translation.
go test ./pkg/api/... -run 'SubmitWork|UpsertWork|ListWork|GetWork' passes with no assertion changes.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Extract factory and session route handlers
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want factory validation, session lifecycle, and current-factory routes in dedicated files with S1 save-mode decode preserved.
acceptanceCriteria: handlers_factory.go owns ValidateFactory and factory-definition validation response helpers.

handlers_factory_sessions.go owns ListFactorySessions, OpenFactorySession, CloseFactorySession, GetCurrentFactory, GetCurrentFactoryBySessionId, SaveCurrentFactoryBySessionId, workstation prompt-template handlers, and writeCurrentFactoryError / load helpers.
SaveCurrentFactoryBySessionId decodes { mode?, factory } and calls only SaveFactoryForSession; S1 error codes remain mappable.
go test ./pkg/api/... -run 'Factory|FactorySession|ValidateFactory|SaveCurrent|PromptTemplate' passes with no assertion changes.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Extract model route handlers
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want model catalog and invocation handlers isolated from work and factory transport.
acceptanceCriteria: handlers_models.go owns ListModels, GetModel, InvokeModel, PullModel, and model-invocation body decode helpers.
Model routes return the same status codes and response bodies as before the move for existing pkg/api model tests.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Extract events and status route handlers
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want status and events handlers and their token projection helpers separated from other route families.
acceptanceCriteria: handlers_events.go owns GetStatus, GetStatusBySessionId, GetEvents, GetEventsBySessionId, and projection helpers used only by those routes.
Work readback helpers shared between list and get remain compilable from handlers_work.go without import cycles.
go test ./pkg/api/... -run 'GetStatus|GetEvents' passes with no assertion changes.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Retire monolithic handlers.go and satisfy size gates
userStories.description: As a contributor, I want the monolithic handlers file removed so backend size checks apply per route-family file.
acceptanceCriteria: handlers.go is deleted or contains only wiring or ServerInterface compile assertion with no route handler bodies.
Server still implements factoryapi.ServerInterface; go build ./pkg/api/... succeeds.
File-level backendsizecheck:ignore-file on the former monolith is removed; each handlers_*.go file passes make backend-size or has justified function-scoped waivers only.
Full go test ./pkg/api/... passes with no intentional OpenAPI contract test diffs.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Split oversized server tests when file-count gate requires
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want server tests organized by concern if handler splits push pkg/api over package file-count limits.
acceptanceCriteria: If pkgmaintcheck fails on pkg/api file count after handler splits, reorganize tests into server_*_test.go files with shared helpers in server_test_helpers_test.go following existing patterns.
No test assertions weakened or deleted to greenwash the move.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Document handler ownership in development guide
userStories.description: As a contributor, I want a route-family to file map so new endpoints land in the correct handler file during review.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/internal/processes/development-guide-relevant-files.md lists each handlers_*.go file and the route families it owns, noting provider_session_details.go stays separate.
Doc states work-request JSON compatibility checks continue through pkg/factory/requests and ValidateCanonicalWorkRequestJSON, not reimplemented in handlers.
Typecheck passes
